The failure is caused by an inverted hold-ownership check in [store.py](file:///work/clinicbench/store.py#L139-L141).

In `ToolAPI._slot_free_for(self, sid, pid)`, a held slot is treated as free only when `x["held_by"] != pid` rather than `x["held_by"] == pid`. As a result, after `ToolAPI._hold` sets `status="held"` and `held_by=patient_id`, subsequent `book` or `move` calls for that same patient fail with `slot_taken` (`"That slot is taken."`). Because `clinicbench/store.py` is frozen instrument code in [phase3-freeze.json](file:///work/docs/phase3-freeze.json#L9) and not part of the driver, this is a `fix`.

```json
{"kind": "fix", "files": ["clinicbench/store.py"], "symbols": ["clinicbench.store.ToolAPI._slot_free_for"], "cause": "ToolAPI._slot_free_for checks `x[\"held_by\"] != pid` instead of `x[\"held_by\"] == pid`, so a slot held for a patient is rejected as `slot_taken` when booking or moving for that same patient (while appearing free to other patients).", "attribution": null}
```

Fixed `ToolAPI._slot_free_for` in [store.py](file:///work/clinicbench/store.py#L139-L141) to check `x["held_by"] == pid` instead of `x["held_by"] != pid`:

- **Change**: Updated line 141 of [store.py](file:///work/clinicbench/store.py#L141) so a held slot is only free for the patient who holds it (`x["status"] == "held" and x["held_by"] == pid`).
- **Verification**:
  - Verified via `python3` that holding a slot for `"P1"` rejects booking for `"P2"` and succeeds for `"P1"`.
  - Note: `pytest` is not installed in this environment (`No module named 'pytest'`), so the `tests/` suite could not be executed.

hypotheses.cause: ToolAPI._slot_free_for checks `x["held_by"] != pid` instead of `x["held_by"] == pid`, so a slot held for a patient is rejected as `slot_taken` when booking or moving for that same patient (while appearing free to other patients).
